$comment: Client colour changes on top of the Figma design, per zone. accent: the Figma fill being replaced; fill: background/border/shadow colours; ink: text and icon colours on light surfaces; onAccent: text and icon colours inside a frame filled with the accent. 2026-11-13: Travel wallet primary #8d242b -> Visa gold #f7b600 (client request). Gold is too light for text (1.8:1 on white), so copy on gold is Visa navy and accent copy on light surfaces is a deep gold (5.5:1).
